thread:
aisha: FYI ACME just asked to expand the POC: add semantic search (embeddings) + BYO-KMS for keying. they want the same 2-week timeline. any red flags?

sam: big red flag is BYO-KMS + hosted private control plane in 2w. integration + approval usually 3-4w. also embeddings add perf + storage work.

aisha: understood. customer insists on 2w because of exec demo. can we scope a minimal runway to demo?

sam: we can do a thin demo path: 1) hosted inference + our managed KMS (fast) OR 2) hosted with envelope keys as a stopgap. both avoid full BYO integration.

aisha: what's the delta on pricing if we go hosted-with-temporary-managed-kms vs Dedicated capacity?

ethan: high level: hosted + managed KMS = normal usage pricing. Dedicated reserved capacity adds base monthly commit + lower per-token cost. BYO-KMS private deployment means enterprise license + infra + integration quote. I can draft numbers but need usage estimates (qps, avg tokens).

aisha: they estimate 100 qps peak, 1k tokens per convo average.

sam: ok with 100 qps, we need to verify model choice. for embeddings pipeline: approximate throughput test command we use: 
```
ri bench --model open-embedding-xl --tokens 512 --concurrency 32 --batching auto
```
this will show latency and throughput tradeoffs.

priya: security note: BYO-KMS triggers extra legal & architecture review: HSM procurement or customer KMS network peering. need answers in the questionnaire about key rotation policy, who holds key material, and egress controls. expect 2-3 weeks.

aisha: can we surface minimal success criteria for the exec demo so we can keep the 2w commitment?

ethan: propose minimal success criteria for 2-week demo: 
- end-to-end demo working with hosted inference + managed KMS (no BYO)
- semantic search returns top-5 relevant docs in demo prompt for 3 canonical queries (>0.7 relevance score)
- p95 tail latency for search flow < 500ms in demo environment
- basic DMAR/PII redaction check passed on sample corpus

aisha: that's good. customer wants production KPIs too — they asked for p95 < 200ms and continuity under failover. we should flag that as post-demo.

sam: p95 <200ms is achievable on Dedicated with optimized KV caching + 8-bit quantization on LLM rerank step, but expect ~3-4x lower cost efficiency tradeoff vs 16-bit. accuracy drop ~1-3% depending on model.

priya: also call out: quantization may affect our compliance posture when we promise no model hallucination; add regressive evals to watch.

aisha: can we do the regressive evals during the 2w POC?

ethan: yes — we can run a small eval harness over their canonical prompts. needs their labeled relevance for ~150 prompt-doc pairs. that will let us track quality delta for quantization & caching.

sam: timeline suggestion: 
- Day 0-2: get customer sample corpus + 150 labeled pairs + KMS SOW decision (managed vs BYO)
- Day 3-7: baseline run: embeddings generation + search rerank + perf bench on hosted env
- Day 8-11: integrate caching & quantized model variant for rerank, run regression evals
- Day 12-14: prepare demo (canary routing, dashboards, failover script)

aisha: if customer insists on BYO-KMS, we push schedule: +2-3w for integration and legal signoff. we should present both tracks in the next call.

priya: I'll prepare the short KMS checklist we can share (networking, encryption policy, rotation, audit logs).

ethan: I'll write the success-criteria doc and include the exact eval metrics we need.

sam: I'll spin up a quick bench and share numbers; if we need a lower latency target (200ms) we'll demo on a small Dedicated footprint and show cost delta.

deploy-bot: Canary for sales/poc-acme started by sam at 1772004500.

aisha: thanks all — I'll sync with the customer and present two tracks (fast demo w/ managed kms vs full BYO path) in tomorrow's call. tagging @sam @priya for followups. :thumbsup:
